source.author: verg
source.text: Non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, ferrea vox, omnis scelerum comprendere formas, omnia poenarum percurrere nomina possim.
source.text_original: Non, mihi si linguae centum sint oraque centum, / ferrea vox, omnis scelerum comprendere formas, / omnia poenarum percurrere nomina possim.'
source.text_english: No, even if I had a hundred tongues, a hundred mouths, and a voice of iron, I could not comprehend all the forms of crimes, nor run through all the names of punishments.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Si cuncta mei corporis membra uerterentur in linguas et omnes artus humana uoce resonarent, nihil dignum sanctae ac uenerabilis Paulae uirtutibus dicerem.
reuse.text_original: Si cuncta mei corporis membra uerterentur in linguas et omnes artus humana uoce resonarent, nihil dignum sanctae ac uenerabilis Paulae uirtutibus dicerem.
reuse.text_english: If all the members of my body were turned into tongues and all my limbs rang out with human speech, I would say nothing worthy of the virtues of the holy and venerable Paula.
